🎥 Hey everyone! I’m Kartika Agarwal, and welcome to my YouTube channel — Physio’s Healing Touch!

Here, you’ll find informative, easy-to-understand videos all about physiotherapy — from treatment techniques to practical tips that can help you stay healthy and pain-free.

💡 My mission is to make physiotherapy more popular and accessible, and to help people understand how powerful it can be in improving your quality of life.

If you find my videos helpful, don’t forget to like, share, and subscribe to Physio’s Healing Touch — your one-stop destination for physiotherapy knowledge!

📲 And don’t forget to join me on Instagram for exclusive notes, updates, and informative content!
